versions.changelog: Refresh for Checkly CLI 9.4.0–9.5.0: config-relative construct paths, accurate automatic-repair support, pnpm 12 lockfile safety, and corrected construct hierarchy.
Refresh through Checkly CLI 9.3.0: adds account plan, entitlement, organization usage, credit projection, pagination, warning/error, and authentication guidance.
Refresh through Checkly CLI 9.2.0: adds accurate Playwright runtime engine detection and resilient lockfile-pruning cache, timeout, and debug guidance.
Refresh through Checkly CLI 9.1.0: Node.js 22.13 floor, Status Page V3 constructs, runner.cache.install.version migration, collected config diagnostics, and current Node 24 GitHub Actions.
Refresh for Checkly CLI 8.23.0–8.23.2: package embedding/pruning, runner registry routing, lockfile behavior, credential precedence, logicalId examples, and dependency-cache guidance.
Refresh through Checkly CLI 8.22.0: adds private Playwright package embedding, lockfile/failure/cache guidance, correct CLI-side registry authentication, and local API/MQTT endpoint scoping.

Refresh for Checkly CLI 8.20.0–8.21.0: adds persistent dependency-cache invalidation, structured check/monitor intent, CLI-versus-MCP routing, Playwright intent caveats, and corrected URL monitor request examples.
Refresh for Checkly CLI 8.19.0: account-aware response-time ceilings for API checks and TCP, DNS, URL, gRPC, SSL, and traceroute monitors; clarifies top-level thresholds versus request assertions.
Refresh for Checkly CLI 8.18.0: adds safe checks run guidance, async test scheduling behavior, and Telegram forum-topic alerts.

Refresh for Checkly CLI 8.17.1: updates SSL property-scoped assertion builders, expanded certificate/connection properties, gRPC health-status wire-value guidance, and removes obsolete storeResponseBody guidance.
Refresh for Checkly CLI 8.16.0: rebuilds import plan/apply/commit/cancel guidance, adds agent confirmation-command safety, deploy preview deletion review, and updated SSL/traceroute diagnostics.
Refreshed Checkly CLI skills through v8.15.0: added gRPC, SSL, and traceroute monitor guidance, reporter diagnostics, automatic .npmrc bundling notes, and 14-skill Agent Skills discovery packaging.
Refreshed Checkly CLI skills through v8.14.1: added deploy --preserve-resources guidance, destructive-delete guard notes, detached-resource preview output guidance, and v8.11 auth/destroy updates.
Refresh Checkly CLI skills for 8.10.0 deploy cancellation and HTTPS DNS monitor guidance
Refresh Checkly CLI skills for 8.9.0 alerting investigation, Slack App alert-channel guidance, checks get result payload behavior, and agentic cancellation/session inspection guidance.
Refresh Checkly CLI skills for 8.7.0 members and test-sessions commands
Document checkly deploy --verbose from upstream 7.12.0 and refresh deploy troubleshooting guidance.
Fix ClawHub security scan - Add credential metadata declarations (CHECKLY_API_KEY, CHECKLY_ACCOUNT_ID). Metadata-only change, no functional updates.
Initial release: Comprehensive Checkly CLI skill with 12 sub-skills, 8 templates, 4 scripts, and 2 reference guides. Complete monitoring-as-code workflow coverage.
